== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* His ID '''AHaHaCiK''' (''Cyrillic:'' АНаНаСиК) comes from the Russian word for "pineapple."<ref>[https://youtu.be/T62GY0bCQSk?t=244 MSI 2019 Play-In Group Stage Day 3 Interviews] ''youtube.com''</ref> More specifically, Russian word "ананáс" means pineapple (ananas), and "ик" (transliterated to Latin as "ik") is a diminutive suffix in Russian, carrying a meaning of either object's small size or adorable appearance. So his ID "ананáсик" means "a small and cute pineapple".
** This was frequently commented upon by English language casters during [[MSI 2019]] and the [[2019 World Championship]]. 
* He practiced kickboxing for 7 years.
